arguments.command:
python -c "
from more_itertools import split_at

# Test split_at with keep_separator=True
print('=== split_at keep_separator=True ===')
result = list(split_at('a,b,c,d', lambda x: x == ',', keep_separator=True))
print(result)  # [['a', ','], ['b', ','], ['c', ','], ['d']]
assert result == [['a', ','], ['b', ','], ['c', ','], ['d']], f'Got {result}'

# Test without maxsplit (all splits)
result2 = list(split_at('a,b,c,d', lambda x: x == ',', keep_separator=True, maxsplit=None))
print(result2)
assert result2 == [['a', ','], ['b', ','], ['c', ','], ['d']]

# Test with maxsplit=1 and keep_separator=True  
result3 = list(split_at('a,b,c,d', lambda x: x == ',', keep_separator=True, maxsplit=1))
print(result3)  # [['a', ','], ['b', 'c', 'd']]
assert result3 == [['a', ','], ['b', 'c', 'd']], f'Got {result3}'

# Test with maxsplit=2 and keep_separator=True
result4 = list(split_at('a,b,c,d', lambda x: x == ',', keep_separator=True, maxsplit=2))
print(result4)  # [['a', ','], ['b', ','], ['c', 'd']]
assert result4 == [['a', ','], ['b', ','], ['c', 'd']], f'Got {result4}'

print('All assertions passed!')
"
